title: Continuum game manifest v0
description: Describes a game package: what it makes, what it reads, what its slot fields mean, and the license for its art and data. Linked from the package's MVR metadata as continuum.manifest, with its SHA-256 as continuum.manifest_hash.

name.description: Display name. Not trusted: trust follows the package ID.

package.description: Original package ID; must match the MVR package that links this manifest.

open_slots.description: Exposes uid_mut for other games' slots.

retire.description: Draft Rule 4. Whether and how other games may retire (use up) objects of this type. Retired objects are frozen, not deleted.

allowed.description: no: never; approved: only games the author or owner approved; anyone: any game, with the owner's signature.

rules.description: Plain words: grades, maturity, cooldowns, owner approval.

slots.description: Slots this package attaches to other games' objects.

on.description: Full type the slot attaches to, 0x…::module::Struct.

reads.description: Outside types or CAIP-19 collections this package reads or derives from.

art.description: SPDX ID or URL, e.g. CC0-1.0.

data.description: SPDX ID or URL for on-chain fields and state.

custody.description: Optional. How the objects are held and moved, so other games know what they can do. Information only.

kiosk.description: Objects are held in Sui Kiosks; take out with kiosk::borrow_val and put back in the same transaction.

locked.description: Objects are locked in kiosks: they leave only through a sale that passes the transfer policy.

notes.description: Plain words on sale rules or exits, e.g. royalty, ascension path.
